title: Loan Accounting Note: Figuring the Farmstead Split Paydown on Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
When a member asks to split the farmstead out of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage, the paydown the member makes from their own funds is the shortfall that leaves the loan within the post-split limit once the release price is applied. It is figured as follows.

## Definitions

1. **Post-split limit.** The product's largest principal after a release, as a percentage of the value still mortgaged.
2. **Homesite.** The parcel of land use farmstead still mortgaged.
3. **Values.** The homesite's value and the value still mortgaged are the appraised values at mortgage; the value still mortgaged is every parcel mortgaged to the loan less every parcel released from it.
4. **Value that stays mortgaged.** The value still mortgaged less the homesite's value.
5. **Homesite's share of value.** The homesite's value divided by the value still mortgaged.

## The calculation

The release price is counted at the product's release premium on the principal left after the paydown, so the principal after the paydown may be no more than the limit times the value that stays mortgaged, divided by one less the release premium times the homesite's share of the value still mortgaged. The paydown is the principal balance less that most, never below zero, rounded up to the next cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Take a loan with a principal balance of USD 760000.00, parcels still mortgaged appraised at USD 1000000 of which the homesite is USD 250000, on a product whose largest principal after a release is 70 percent and whose release premium is 115 percent.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Value that stays mortgaged | 1000000 less 250000, that is 750000 |
| Limit times the value that stays mortgaged | 70 percent of 750000, that is 525000 |
| Homesite's share of value | 250000 divided by 1000000, that is 0.25 |
| One less the premium times that share | one less 1.15 times 0.25, that is 0.7125 |
| Most principal after the paydown | 525000 divided by 0.7125, that is 736842.105263 |
| Principal balance less that most | 760000.00 less 736842.105263, that is 23157.894737 |
| Rounded up to the next cent | **23157.90** |

**Never below zero.** Had the principal balance been USD 700000.00, below the most of 736842.105263, the paydown would be 0.00.
